api_key.description:
Create an API key in Immich: [{api_keys_url}]({api_keys_url})

Required permissions: **asset.read**, **asset.download**, **memory.read**, **album.read**, **person.read**, **user.read**

missing_permissions.title: Immich API key is missing permissions
missing_permissions.description:
Your Immich Slideshow API key is missing the following permission(s): **{missing}**.

Some enabled photo sources will not work until you grant them. Edit the key in Immich under [API Keys]({url}), add the missing permission(s), and save. No need to re-enter the key here — the warning clears automatically on the next reload.

immich_version_unsupported.title: Immich server is too old
immich_version_unsupported.description:
Your Immich server is **v{version}**, but Immich Slideshow requires at least **v{minimum}**.

Older servers don't expose the API this integration needs, so the slideshow may not work. Please update Immich. This warning clears automatically once the server is up to date.
